senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; r. ארג with format. ז; cmp. אַרְבָּא) box, chest (joined with tenons &c.).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite>; <cite ref="Horayot 12a">Hor. 12ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—
Snh. 46ᵇ kabor (to bury, cover) might mean only דעבד א׳ וכ׳ Ms. F. a. Ar. (Var. ארזג, ed. ארון) one makes a chest and puts the corpse in. [Pr. n. pl. v. אַרְגִּיזָא.]
